0x00080D.en: 「With the strength I've got now...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x00087E.en: 「Guh!@　So this is where it ends...!!」

0x000906.en: 「Dammit!@　You won't get me next time!」

0x0009AF.en: 「Tch!! What a short show that was!」

0x000A2F.en: 「Is this as far as I go...!?」

0x000A67.en: 「Whoops...@　Not my finest moment, is it!」

0x000ADB.en: 「Nngh, so this is where it ends!」

0x000B30.en: 「Tch! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x000B6B.en: 「Like hell I'll screw up here...!@　This ain't funny...」

0x000BBF.en: 「I blew it...!@　Nothing to do but bail...」

0x000D10.en: 「So this is the end... The rest is up to you.」

0x000D42.en: 「Damn it...!@　Is this where it ends!」

0x000DBC.en: 「No good, we took too many hits... Retreating!」

0x000E09.en: 「Well, that's a shame. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000E47.en: 「Eek, I'll leave the rest to you!」

0x000E8E.en: 「To think the Granzon would be shot down...」

0x000F39.en: 「Ngh... So I'm the falling star this time... Ejecting!」

0x000FF0.en: 「Ow ow ow... I give, a miscalculation on my part.」

0x001031.en: 「Well now, looks like they got me good!」

0x001075.en: 「U-ungh! So this is where it ends...!」

0x0010E2.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x001129.en: 「I'm sorry... the rest is up to you.」

0x00115E.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x00124A.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not good enough...!」

0x001298.en: 「No good, I can't take any more! Retreating!」

0x001382.en: 「N-no good! This is as far as I go!!」

0x0013C0.en: 「Well, well, so this is the end.」

0x0013EF.en: 「I can't manage any more. I'll be taking my leave.」

0x00147A.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll have to withdraw here...!」

0x0015E0.en: 「I'm ejecting...@ Ngh...! So much for looking cool...」

0x00169E.en: 「Guuh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x00180D.en: 「So I still have much to learn...!」

0x001932.en: Holy Langran Kingdom, Troia State, Hangou Strait

0x001994.en: 「Hey, Eun. Have we gotten any word from@ the Hagane or the others?」

0x001A06.en: 「I've been trying to make contact ever since@ the Hiryu came to this world, but...」

0x001A6E.en: 「Unlike back on Earth, we can't just use the@ Satellite Link, and with everything piling up,@ long-range comms are next to impossible.」

0x001B5C.en: 「Comms within the operation zone are fine, but@ recent disturbances in the ether flow have made@ long-range comms quite unstable.」

0x001C04.en: 「That's one of the things@ making the chaos even worse.」

0x001C5A.en: 「Kirkus's army manages to keep a communication@ network going by relaying through the high-grade@ transmitters at their bases, but...」

0x001CF3.en: 「Forces outside that range... the Langran troops@ not under General Kirkus's command... we can't@ fully grasp their movements.」

0x001DAA.en: 「And the royal capital, held by the Shutedonias@ army now... goes without saying. To get intel@ we'd need spies or armed recon.」

0x001E98.en: 「The Shutedonias army has strong protections in place.@ On that front, if we had Princess Xenia we might@ manage something, but...」

0x001F43.en: 「The princess... the Langran royals are missing, right?」

0x001F9F.en: 「Then the best way for us to find the Hagane@ is to make a move ourselves...」

0x002010.en: 「If only we could get into comms range of each other.」

0x002053.en: 「We've been making a pretty big splash.@ They're bound to notice us.」

0x0020BE.en: 「Though there's a chance they've sided@ with Shutedonias...」

0x002111.en: 「We'll deal with that if it comes to it.@ Besides, there's no reason for us and@ the Hagane to be fighting in the first place.」

0x002192.en: （Or they could be with@ His Highness Feil...）

0x0021EB.en: 「Ah... a transmission from Kirkus's main force.」

0x00229D.en: 「Yeah. About 50 kilometers north of here there's@ a ruined temple. A few hours ago, a massive@ ground collapse happened there.」

0x002345.en: 「And they want us to find out why. That's not@ our kind of job. Send scholars, scholars.」

0x0023CF.en: 「No... there must be a reason@ they're sending us.」

0x00241C.en: 「That's right.@ There's a chance a temple of Volkruss@ lies underground there.」

0x0024DF.en: 「Isn't that even harder to say?@ But... that word, Volkruss,@ does ring a bell...」

0x002585.en: 「Ah, I remember now!@ Shu mentioned it, back during the <Shura Rebellion>!」

0x0025E3.en: 「Ah... that was before his Granzon@ turned into Neo Granzon.」

0x002648.en: 「I think he called it a god of destruction or something?」

0x00268E.en: 「I knew from the Hiryu's data that you fought@ Shu and defeated him, but...@ so you'd heard the name Volkruss.」

0x002739.en: 「Don't tell me the demon god you mentioned before,@ the one that brings calamity to La Gias...@ that's Volkruss?」

0x0027D2.en: 「That's one theory, but its true nature is unknown.@ Even so, a group exists that worships it as a god@ and seeks its revival.」

0x00288C.en: 「An evil god and its cult of believers.@ If monsters show up next,@ this'll be a full-on fantasy RPG.」

0x002913.en: 「True enough... it is a world with spirits and magic.」

0x002956.en: 「And there's one more concern...@ the collapse of the Harmony Barrier.」

0x0029CE.en: 「A special barrier that covers all of <La Gias>@ from the Tower of Harmony... it limits@ the use of large-scale magic.」

0x002A60.en: 「And supplying it with magic power is@ one of the duties of the Langran royal family, but...」

0x002AE6.en: 「Because of the terrorist attack in the royal capital,@ the <Harmony Barrier> has been broken.」

0x002B60.en: 「Then... this is a situation where Volkruss@ could easily revive, is that it.」

0x002BC8.en: 「Yes.@ If by some chance the god of destruction appears...@ Langran will fall into even greater chaos.」

0x002C55.en: 「Understood. Let's head for the temple ruins at once.」

0x002C9B.en: 「I'll go on ahead in the Granveil.」

0x002D42.en: 「...To think there'd be a cavern like this@ beneath the temple ruins...」

0x002D8F.en: 「And that we could stroll right in@ with our Personal Troopers, no less.」

0x002DF5.en: 「Master, there appear to be no spirits within this cavern.」

0x002E3E.en: 「So the temple of Volkruss really does lie ahead...」

0x002E81.en: 「Ahead, huh... then the temple's gotta be huge, right?@ And if so, why would it be so...」

0x002EFB.en: 「It's for the sake of what's enshrined here.@ Volkruss is called a god, but some say it's the@ massed grudge of a giant race, long extinct.」

0x002FC2.en: 「They thrived in this world tens of millions of@ years ago, with intelligence equal to ours or@ greater, as fossils reveal.」

0x003094.en: 「But the giants were wiped out in a great cataclysm.@ Leaving behind a monstrous grudge against@ every last living thing...」

0x00316D.en: 「This is bad! Everyone, back to your machines!」

0x003231.en: 「Those are weapons made by binding wraith spirits into clay.」

0x003274.en: 「Yang Long,@ if Demon Golems have appeared...」

0x0032C1.en: 「Yeah, there's a good chance a caster is nearby.@ Things may have progressed further@ than we thought.」

0x003357.en: 「Then does that mean Volkruss lies beyond here...?」

0x00339A.en: 「I can't say for certain.@ There are multiple temples of Volkruss.@ Regardless, let's beat them and press on.」

0x003433.en: 「Good, that's all the Demon Golems here.@ Let's move deeper.」

0x00352D.en: 「Oh ho... so you were acquainted with them after all.」

0x003589.en: 「It's been a while, Lord Yang Long.」

0x0035E2.en: 「Magic Priest Louzorl...@ a dark priest who serves Volkruss.」

0x003638.en: 「Thank you for the introduction.@ Still, hearing about the ground collapse and rushing@ straight here so fast... impressive, as I'd expect.」

0x0036EC.en: 「You bastard, what are you gonna do with Leona!?」

0x003723.en: 「She possesses a rather intriguing wave...@ so I thought I'd have her serve as an offering@ to the great Volkruss.」

0x003809.en: 「It seems two others there possess@ the very same thing she does.」

0x003880.en: 「Don't tell me... he means psychic power...!」

0x0038B7.en: 「By offering up Leona,@ will Volkruss be revived?」

0x003907.en: 「There's a principle of magic called the 'law of similarity.'@ Volkruss is a mass of dark emotion, made of@ fear, hatred, and rage.」

0x0039A0.en: 「By the law of similarity,@ things alike in form or essence influence one another.」

0x003A02.en: 「In other words, the offering's fear becomes the key@ to summoning that same negative existence... Volkruss.」

0x003A7F.en: 「How well-versed you are, Lord Yang Long.@ Should you join our Volkruss faith,@ you might make quite a fine priest.」

0x003B2A.en: 「They say the wise speak not of dark powers.@ I won't be swayed by your ravings.」

0x003B89.en: 「I'd rather this temple not be disturbed any further.@ Won't you quietly take your leave?」

0x003C0F.en: 「I can hardly let you go free.」

0x003C40.en: 「Well, well, understood.@ Then, until the offering ritual is complete,@ let these fellows keep you company.」

0x003CD9.en: 「Law of heaven, law of earth, done in reverse, born@ in reverse. Grudge of the netherworld, flame of@ purgatory, sworn in blood and dark.」

0x003DA9.en: 「This is within my god's temple...@ they are stronger than the Demon Golems@ you faced before.」

0x003E2E.en: 「If we take out that Louzorl guy,@ won't that solve things?」

0x003E93.en: 「Not with our current equipment.@ Half of his cursed spirit machine Nagizzard belongs@ to the Astral plane, so we can't damage it.」

0x003F7B.en: 「There's nothing to be done.@ You too, be afraid of this situation.@ That fear will become fuel for my god.」

0x004005.en: 「No, why don't I offer you up as sacrifices too?@　If you'd rather refuse, then you'll be@　cast down into the depths of the underworld.」

0x0040FA.en: 「Hmph...@　Has the terror driven you mad, perhaps?」

0x00414D.en: 「Nah, if anything I'm thrilled.@　I've finally found my darling@　Leona, after all.」

0x0041ED.en: 「Heh... you don't know your place, do you?」

0x004224.en: 「You're the one underestimating us!@　We've got three of the Steel Dragon Squadron's@　best gung-ho brawlers right here!」

0x0042D9.en: 「We're not letting you sacrifice our comrade!」

0x00435F.en: 「You idiot! Don't underestimate the power of my love!!」

0x0043D6.en: （Hm... the convergence rate of the negative energy...@　Could it be affected by their fighting spirit?）

0x004441.en: 「The sacrificial rite is underway.@　If you don't save her within ten minutes,@　it may be too late.」

0x0044C8.en: 「That's more than enough time!@　Let's move, boys! First we save Leona!」

0x00454F.en: 「Everyone, we've only got about@　one minute left till the time limit!」

0x0045A5.en: 「Only thirty seconds till the time limit!@　Hurry!」

0x0045FB.en: 「You didn't make it in time.@　Now then, let us offer the sacrifice@　to Lord Volkruss.」

0x00469E.en: 「...Just as I thought, the power isn't rising.@ So this sacrifice won't do after all.@ No matter, I'll withdraw for now.」

0x00475B.en: 「I still have things I must attend to,@　you see. Until we meet again.」

0x0047F7.en: 「B-but that's lucky for us.@　We had no way to beat that machine...」

0x0048CD.en: 「Order all units back to the ship.@　After that, we return to the surface.」

0x004929.en: 「Heh heh heh... no matter how strong Granveil's@　attacks are, they can't break my Astral Shift.」

0x0049F8.en: 「Valsione, was it?@　You seem to use some intriguing technology,@　but you're no match for my Nagizzard.」

0x004A97.en: 「Guys like you make my skin crawl!@　You disgust me!」

0x004AF3.en: 「To face my Nagizzard and not tremble...」

0x004B39.en: 「Heh, compared to Lt. Katina's discipline and@　an angry Leona, you're nothing!」

0x004BC3.en: 「Now my team's got a full lineup.」

0x004C50.en: 「Still, we got lucky.@　If we hadn't been heading for that temple,@　who knows what would've happened by now...」

0x004CD1.en: 「That was my pull.@　We're bound together by the threads of fate.」

0x004D49.en: 「Leona, do you have any information@　on the other Steel Dragon members?」

0x004DB1.en: 「No... after I came to this world,@　Louzorl captured me, so...」
